title: Delaware Tax Appeal Board — Docket 442 (Tunnell)
text:
Decision of the Tax Appeal Board - Date: June 21, 1972
Docket No. 442
Milfred S. Tunnell, Eolyne K. Tunnell,

James M, Tunnell and Robert W. Tunnell,
t/a Pot-Nets Mobile Home Park

License, Sales, Miscellaneous - Trailer Park License Fee -
Applicability to Mobile Home Facility.

The trailer park license fee (30 Del. C,, Sec. 2301) is not applicable
to mobile home facilities,
